experiment: VACASK: @if area < 2 in a subckt, a sweep of area over [1, 1.5] and over [1, 3]
result: inside the branch: 0.5 / 0.4; across it VACASK re-evaluates the condition: 0.5 / 0.0909 (the 10 kOhm branch)
rules: §3.7 a sweep of a parameter that a structural if reads: VACASK keeps its @if and re-evaluates it at each point (Xyce renders the nominal branch and warns)
